text:
jess: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem - we're seeing recurring OOMs in shard pool B when prefix-heavy traffic spikes. Need owners and short timeline for actions.

omar: I'll own short-term mitigations. Propose adding a soft per-shard memory cap and a lightweight eviction path while we root-cause.

kyle: +1. I'll run jemalloc + pprof captures across affected instances for the next few spikes and automate collection.

ravi: Can heap profiles annotate KV cache hot prefixes? We should correlate with request histograms (seq len, model id).

jess: Proposed plan: (1) soft_limit per-shard (2) per-shard LRU eviction TTL=30m (3) gather pprof + jemalloc stats for 48h. Owners: omar=(1,2), kyle=(3). Timeline: soft limits in 48h, eviction in 72h, profiling 48-96h.

anita: Do canary in us-west-2 only to measure tail-latency impact before global change.

omar: Canary plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 6h increments, rollback on regressions.

kyle: Script I'll use for pprof:```bash
curl -sS http://localhost:9090/debug/pprof/heap > /tmp/heap-$(date +%s).pb
jeprof --text /usr/local/bin/service /tmp/heap-*.pb | head -n 200 > /tmp/jeprof-summary.txt
```

ravi: Also capture jemalloc slab stats via /debug/jemalloc and run every 5m during profiling window.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary assignment created: route=shard-B-canary, capacity=10%, owner=omar, created_by=jess, id=canary-2148429012.

anita: KPIs for canary: 95p latency, token/s throughput, OOM count, cache hit rate. Create /dashboards/shard-b/canary.

omar: I'll open a small PR to add soft_limit env var and per-shard eviction toggle with rollout annotations. Target PR by EOD.

jess: kyle - attach initial oncall checklist when scripts are ready.

kyle: Checklist draft: 1) deploy canary 10% 2) monitor 15m 3) if OOM or >2x error rate rollback to 0% 4) collect profiles upload to /s3/oom-profiles/2148429012/ 5) escalate if unresolved in 2h.

ravi: Recommend jemalloc decay tweaks on canary nodes: MALLOC_CONF=decay_time:1,lg_dirty_mult:16 behind env toggle.

omar: Adding env toggle to PR.

anita: Who owns long-term remediation? Need a single tracking ticket for GC/allocator work, slab tuning, and KV refactor.

jess: I'll create a GH issue post-canary. Provisional long-term owners: ravi (allocator/profiling), kyle (observability), omar (runtime eviction/policy).

sre-bot: reminder: incident follow-up template: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/template - add remediation ticket before closing.

kyle: Profile job live now; will post /s3 path after first dump.

jess: Thanks all. Reconvene after 24h of profiling. If blockers, @here. :thumbsup:
